additions.note: Mistral released weights for its multimodal coding and cybersecurity model after the October 6 API preview. Its open-weight license limits model-as-a-service offerings.
Modular patch updates the multilingual speech recognition model and decision adapter; the Granite Switch 4.1 base remains unchanged.
Promptable speech model for transcription in 40 languages, speaker attribution, translation and audio questions; supports recordings up to one hour.
Apache-licensed 8B and 30B modular models combine chat, decision and safety adapters with speech recognition on one endpoint. Model cards date the release October 14; IBM announced it October 15.

before.note: Natively multimodal flagship for coding, agents, and enterprise work, available in public API preview through Mistral Studio. Planned open weights are not yet public; Mistral says they will follow by the end of October.

after.note: Natively multimodal flagship for coding, agents, and enterprise work, initially available in public API preview through Mistral Studio. Weights were released October 29 under an open-weight license.

corrections.reason: Weights were released October 29 after the API preview.
